scope: Theorem 2.4 (The free coefficient) of the manuscript “The critical correlation exponent of the planar XY model” (preprints/The-critical-correlation-exponent-of-the-planar-XY-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e58587be77cd0256), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exists a finite a = a(b) ≥ 0 such that am(b) → a. Let Bn, at mesh n−1, be any sequence of free axis rectangles with endpoints converging to those of a nondegenerate rectangle B. For every finite collection of smooth shifts defined near B, log E exp{⟨h, ABn g(·/n)⟩} −→ a 2 Z B |∇g|2 . (2.4) Joint limits are Gaussian, with covariance a R B ∇g · ∇g′, and all joint moments converge. For zero-total profiles fn whose scaled densities converge in L2(B) to a bounded piecewise continuous f of integral zero, log Ee⟨h,fn⟩ −→ a 2 ⟨f, (−∆B,N )−1 f⟩L2(B). (2.5) Face smears, after subtracting their totals from a volume smear, are allowed as well. These limits may be degenerate when a = 0.
